'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****The [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy|Navy]] reports that 33 ships passed through the [[Strait of Hormuz]] after receiving permission in the past 24 hours. [https://www.iranintl.com/en/202605245602 (Iran International)]
***The [[Armed Forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran|Iranian military]] shoots down an alleged [[Israel]]i surveillance drone over [[Hormozgan province]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.iranintl.com/en/202605245997 (Iran International)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***The [[Security Service of Ukraine|Ukrainian Security Service]] reports that [[Ukrainian forces]] have successfully launched an overnight [[drone warfare|drone strike]] on the [[Vtorovo]] oil pumping station in the [[Vladimir Oblast]] in [[Russia]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-strikes-major-russian-oil-pumping-station-supplying-moscow-oblast-sbu-says/ (''Kyiv Independent'')]

The [[National Chernobyl Museum]] is severely damaged, among other buildings. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/clyp6831yp5o (BBC News)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2026/05/24/russian-attack-kills-4-ukraine-uses-oreshnik-missile/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://meduza.io/feature/2026/05/24/udar-rossii-po-kievu-24-maya-bespretsedentnyy-po-kolichestvu-postradavshih-muzeev-i-drugih-kulturnyh-uchrezhdeniy (''Meduza'')]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**[[2026 Quetta train bombing]]
***At least 30 people are killed and over 52 are injured after the explosion of a bomb at a car park near a [[train station]] in [[Quetta]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. The [[Balochistan Liberation Army]] claims responsibility. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/5/24/bomb-attack-in-pakistans-balochistan-province-kills-more-than-20-people (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.independenturdu.com/node/186030 (The Independent Urdu)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[2026 Blue Nile campaign]]
***[[Sudanese Armed Forces]] announces that they have seized control of Al-Barka in the [[Blue Nile State|Blue Nile]] region of [[Sudan]]. The SAF's Fourth Infantry Division confirmed the military operation in a statement. [https://sudantribune.com/article/314335 (''Sudan Tribune'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Angeles City building collapse]]
**A [[Malaysia]]n citizen dies after a nine-story building, under construction as a [[condo-hotel]], collapses in [[Angeles City|Angeles]], [[Pampanga]], [[Philippines]]. At least 26 people are rescued, while [[Search and rescue|search operations]] are ongoing for 23 others still missing. [https://www.philstar.com/headlines/2026/05/25/2530337/malaysian-dead-23-missing-angeles-building-collapse (''The Philippine Star'')] [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/building-construction-collapse-philippines-dozens-trapped-angeles-city-manila-6138596 (CNA)]
*Five people are killed and another is injured in a fire at a shop in [[Qidong County]], [[Hunan]], [[China]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260524/750c8ba5325e4a9b9f6eee3004dc6d24/c.html (Xinhua)]
*Three people are killed and 17 others are reported missing after overnight torrential rains in [[Yongchuan, Chongqing|Yongchuan]], [[Chongqing]], China. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/three-dead-17-missing-after-flooding-chinas-chongqing-2026-05-24/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Bahrain–Iran relations]], [[Reactions to the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[Bahrain]] sentences nine people to [[life in prison]] for [[Iranian external operations|espionage]] on behalf of Iran's [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]]. [https://www.iranintl.com/en/202605241561 (Iran International)]
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]]
**Hundreds of inmates [[Prison riot|seize control]] of a [[Prisons in Venezuela|prison]] in [[Barinas (state)|Barinas]], [[Venezuela]], and protest alleged [[Torture in Venezuela|torture]] and [[Human rights in Venezuela|abuse]], demanding the removal of the prison director as [[Law enforcement in Venezuela|security forces]] surround the facility. [https://thesun.my/news/world-news/inmates-alleging-torture-take-over-venezuelan-prison/ (AFP via ''The Sun'')]
*Four people are killed, including a village chief and a police officer, and four others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Santo Tomas, Isabela|Santo Tomas]], [[Isabela (province)|Isabela]], [[Philippines]]. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2234002/cop-village-chair-among-4-killed-in-isabela-shooting (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025–2026 Iranian protests]]
**[[2026 Iranian diaspora protests]]
***[[Iranian Americans]] gather in [[San Francisco]], [[California]], [[United States]] at the [[San Francisco Ferry Building|Ferry Building]] opposing an immediate end to the [[2026 Iran war|Iran war]], citing concerns that it would leave the [[Islamic Republic of Iran|Islamic Republic]] [[Government of Iran|regime]] in power and undermine hopes for change in the country. [https://www.cbsnews.com/sanfrancisco/news/iranian-americans-san-francisco-rally-oppose-immediate-end-war-iran/ (CBS San Francisco)]
*[[2026 Cypriot legislative election]]
**[[Cyprus|Cypriots]] vote to elect 56 of the 80 seats in the [[House of Representatives (Cyprus)|House of Representatives]]. Recent opinion polls have indicated that the conservative [[Democratic Rally|DISY]] and the leftist [[Progressive Party of Working People|AKEL]] are competing for first place, while the hard-right [[ELAM (Cyprus)|ELAM]] is also expected to make gains in the legislature. [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2026/05/24/cyprus-parliamentary-elections-disy-and-akel-race-for-first-place-as-far-right-make-gains (''Euronews'')] [https://www.dw.com/en/cyprus-election-expected-to-shake-up-national-politics/a-77260976 (DW)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/cyprus-votes-new-parliament-with-corruption-living-costs-focus-2026-05-24/ (Reuters)]
**DISY wins the most with 17 seats, followed by AKEL in second with 15 seats and ELAM in third with eight seats. [[ALMA – Citizens for Cyprus|ALMA]] and [[Direct Democracy Cyprus]] enter the legislature with four seats each. [https://en.philenews.com/politics/cyprus-election-2026-final-results-disy-wins-elam-surges/ (''Phileleftheros'')]
*[[2025–2026 Turkish protests]]
**[[Turkey|Turkish]] [[General Directorate of Security (Turkey)|police]] raid the headquarters of the [[Republican People's Party]] and evict its leadership, including [[Özgür Özel]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20260524-turkey-riot-police-use-tear-gas-to-drive-ousted-opposition-leader-from-party-hq (AFP via France 24)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c87qwrqre83o (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkey-orders-police-evict-ousted-opposition-leadership-headquarters-2026-05-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 Beninese presidential election]]
**[[Romuald Wadagni]] is sworn in as the [[president of Benin]], succeeding [[Patrice Talon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/benins-wadagni-takes-office-vows-better-living-standards-security-2026-05-24/ (Reuters)]
*Residents of [[Kraków]], [[Poland]], have overwhelmingly backed the dismissal of [[Mayor of the Royal Capital City of Kraków|Mayor]] [[Aleksander Miszalski]] ([[Civic Platform]]) and the city council in a local [[Recall election|recall referendum]] for the first time in the city's history. [[Exit poll]]s have shown a 33.4% voter turnout with 97.8% of voters backing dismissing Miszalski, while 96.0% supported removing the council. [https://tvpworld.com/93433594/krakow-mayor-miszalski-ousted-in-referendum-exit-poll-show (TVP World)]
*In [[Senegal]], [[Malick Ndiaye]] resigns as [[National Assembly (Senegal)|National Assembly]] [[List of presidents of the National Assembly of Senegal|president]] following the dismissal of [[Prime Minister of Senegal|prime minister]] [[Ousmane Sonko]], clearing the way for Sonko to seek the parliament's presidency amid tensions within [[PASTEF|the ruling coalition]]. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2026/05/24/senegal-s-parliament-speaker-steps-down-amid-political-crisis_6753784_4.html (AFP via ''Le Monde'')] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-05-24/senegal-parliament-speaker-ally-of-former-pm-sonko-resigns (Bloomberg)]
*Thousands of people protest in [[Madrid]], [[Spain]], against increasing housing costs. [https://apnews.com/article/spain-housing-crisis-protest-airbnb-4faabcdaa459c5544cb8b7aacc6c67d0 (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2026 IndyCar Series]]
**[[2026 Indianapolis 500]]
***In [[auto racing]], [[Meyer Shank Racing|Meyer Shank]]'s [[Felix Rosenqvist]] defeats [[Team Penske|Penske]]'s [[David Malukas]] to win the 110th [[Indianapolis 500]], giving Meyer Shank its second victory in the event.
